howto: Press Play, then tap an empty field. Pick a seed and drag your finger (or mouse) over more fields to plant a whole row at once.
When the crops glow gold they are ripe. Tap them, or drag across a row, to harvest. Animals and workshops show a glowing icon when something is ready to collect.
Sell crops at the market, fill orders on the order board and load Marta's boat for coins and XP. Spend coins on workshops, animal pens, new fields and decorations as you level up.
Follow the goal bar along the bottom: twelve story chapters lead to the first Lantern Fair. Drag to look around, pinch to zoom, twist two fingers to turn the farm, or use the buttons on the right.
tips: Wheat ripens in about 20 seconds, so it is the quickest way to your first few levels.
Bigger, slower crops sell for much more. Plant them before you close the game: the farm keeps growing while you are away.
Drag one finger across several fields to plant or harvest a whole row in one swipe.
Feed your animals before collecting eggs and milk. Hungry animals wait for you, they never get sick.
Turn the farm with two fingers, or tap the rotate and tilt buttons. Double-tap a building to zoom to it.
Open the Daily gift each morning: a streak takes a rest day when you miss one, so it never resets harshly.

controls.keyboard: Click to tap. WASD or arrow keys pan the camera, Q and E rotate, R and F tilt, mouse wheel or + and - zoom, right-drag orbits, Home returns to the farm. Esc closes a panel, P pauses.
controls.touch: Tap to plant, harvest and open things. Drag with one finger to look around (or to plant and harvest a row when a seed is chosen), pinch to zoom, twist two fingers to rotate, and use the buttons on the right to turn and tilt.

difficulty: A relaxed farm with no fail state and no pressure timers. Crops and animals wait for you; progress never disappears. The pace scales with your level from 1 to 50, and Settings lets you fix the time of day and weather and pick the graphics quality.

cheats.effect: Every crop, animal and workshop batch is ready
Every field, animal pen and workshop is built

features.autosave: The farm saves after every action, when the tab is hidden and every few seconds (localStorage key claireFarm.save with a version number, a backup copy and a migration chain)
features.goals-or-quests: Twelve story chapters with a goal bar, daily quests with a chest, an order board, Marta's boat orders, seasonal event baskets and awards
features.day-time-ui: Live day and night cycle with lamps and stars, real seasons and weather; Settings can lock the time of day
features.inventory: The barn: item counts, capacity and upgrades, and the market to sell from it
features.progression: Levels 1 to 50 with an XP curve, new crops, animals, workshops and recipes at set levels, expansion fields, decorations, wardrobe cosmetics, a critter album, awards and a daily gift streak
features.tutorial: The first play is guided by Milo and a pointing hand; replay it from Settings or the arcade Tutorial button
features.offline-progress: Crops, animals and workshop batches keep going while the game is closed; a kind welcome-back card adds a capped thank-you of up to four hours
features.graphics: Adaptive quality: 3D lighting with soft sun shadows and haze, instanced grass and trees; drops resolution and effects by itself if a phone gets warm

settings.quality: Settings: Graphics quality Auto, High, Medium or Low
